message.content:
In this repository, find where "memo" lifecycle events (e.g. created, updated, deleted, archived, published, etc.) trigger/dispatch webhooks.

I need:
1. Each memo lifecycle event that dispatches a webhook, and the name of the function that does the dispatching for that event (with file path and line number).
2. Where all these dispatch calls converge — i.e., is there a single common delivery function (e.g. something that actually does the HTTP POST to the webhook URL)? Give its name, file path, and line number.

Search for terms like "webhook", "Webhook", "dispatchWebhook", "memo" combined with "webhook", event hooks/pubsub around memo create/update/delete, etc. Look in store/service layers (likely Go, given "memo" — this could be the memos project). Report precisely with file:line citations.

This confirms that archiving/pinning/visibility changes all go through `UpdateMemo` (single RPC handling field_mask paths including `state` for archive/restore, `pinned`, `visibility`) and thus route through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` with activity type `memos.memo.updated`. There isn't a distinct "archived" or "published" webhook event type — those are just updates.

Now I have a complete picture. Let me verify line numbers precisely with grep -n for final citations.

content.text:
I now have a complete, verified picture of the memo webhook dispatch chain. Here's the report (all in the [usememos/memos](https://github.com/usememos/memos) repository, Go code). ## 1. Memo lifecycle events that dispatch webhooks | Event / activity type | Dispatch function | Called from (trigger site) | |---|---|---| | `memos.memo.created` | `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` | `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157` (RPC handler starts at line 70) | | `memos.memo.updated` | `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:20` | Indirectly via helper `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:66-78`, calls `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` at line 67). That helper is invoked from:
• `APIV1Service.UpdateMemo` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:513` (handler starts line 401) — this single RPC handles **all** field-mask updates including `state` (archive/restore, lines 467-469), `pinned` (line 465-466), `visibility` (line 452-464), and `content`, so archive/restore/pin/visibility changes all surface as `memos.memo.updated` webhooks, not distinct event types.
• `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:48`
• `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:48` | | `memos.memo.deleted` | `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:25` | `APIV1Service.DeleteMemo` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:562` (handler starts line 518) | | `memos.memo.comment.created` | `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:30` | `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:119` (handler starts line 20) | All three of `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`/`DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`/`DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` funnel into a shared private helper: - `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook(ctx, memo, activityType)` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48-74`, which looks up the memo creator's webhooks (`s.Store.GetUserWebhooks`) and, for each configured webhook, calls `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` at line 71. `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` does the same lookup/loop inline (not via `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`) and also calls `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:43`. Note: memos does not have a separate "archived" or "published" webhook event; archiving/restoring/pinning a memo goes through the generic `UpdateMemo` RPC and thus emits `memos.memo.updated`. ## 2. Where dispatch converges — the actual HTTP delivery function All roads lead to `internal/webhook/webhook.go`: - **`PostAsync(requestPayload *WebhookRequestPayload)`** — `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go:184-196`. This is the immediate convergence point called by all dispatch sites above (it just enqueues the payload onto a bounded channel `asyncPostQueue`, non-blocking). - **`Post(requestPayload *WebhookRequestPayload) error`** — `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go:120-180`. This is the true single delivery function that performs the actual HTTP POST (`http.NewRequest("POST", ...)` at line 126, executed via the SSRF-guarded `safeClient.Do(req)` at line 152). It also handles HMAC signing (Standard Webhooks style, lines 133-150) and response validation (lines 158-179). The link between the two: a fixed pool of 4 background goroutines, started in `init()` at `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`, continuously drains `asyncPostQueue` and calls `Post(payload)` (line 46) for each queued item. So the call graph is: ``` CreateMemo / UpdateMemo / DeleteMemo / CreateMemoComment -> DispatchMemo*Webhook (memo_service_webhooks.go) -> dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook (or inline loop for comments) -> webhook.PostAsync() [enqueue] -> (async worker goroutine, webhook.go:44-53) -> webhook.Post() [single true HTTP delivery function] ```
